sources.title: Introducing Laguna S 2.1 - poolside.ai
sources.snippet: Today we're releasing Laguna S 2.1, a significant step forward in our development of models that pursue longer horizon work and make effective use of reasoning. Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 8B activated parameters per token and supports a context window of up to 1M tokens in thinking and no-thinking modes. sources.title: Model release notes - Poolside
sources.snippet: Compatibility notes Laguna S 2.1 is designed for Poolside Agent CLI workflows and OpenAI-compatible API integrations. Download the weights from the Laguna S 2.1 Hugging Face model card. Run Laguna S 2.1 locally through pool, vLLM, SGLang, Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, or NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, or access it through OpenRouter and the Poolside API.

sources.snippet: Laguna S 2.1 Overview Laguna S 2.1 is a Mixture-of-Experts model built for agentic coding and extended reasoning. It is the larger sibling of Laguna XS 2.1, trading a bigger memory footprint for stronger coding and reasoning performance while keeping a small activated-parameter count so it stays practical to run on a single high-memory machine.
